recommended_mode.mode_consistency_note: S1 surfaced scatter + incoherence (refactor signals) but the S1 aspiration answer (A-S1-02) selected 'all three,' including evaluating whether programs still make sense (a redesign-shaped signal). The tension was surfaced explicitly and resolved by the respondents: on the change-tolerance fork (A-S2-01) they chose 'document and set aside' rather than making policy calls, and on the purpose-linkage question (A-S2-02) they chose to document stated purpose as a factual matter rather than evaluating adequacy. S1/S2/S6 therefore all point to refactor.

scope_sentence.text: Map the current (as of today's snapshot date) federal commercial lending subsidy/guarantee programs administered by SBA, USDA, Commerce, Interior, Energy, Education, HHS, and similar agencies — documenting each program's current rules, standards, and stated statutory/regulatory purpose, flagging pending/proposed legislative and rulemaking changes as 'not yet law,' and listing cross-program divergences and conflicts as an explicit open-items list rather than resolving them — as an advisory deliverable to inform a working group's decision whether to fund a fuller consolidation program, by December 1, 2026, treating state-level lending programs, consumer/mortgage subsidies, and grants/direct-spending programs as boundary regimes.

decision_served.text: A working group/commission decides whether to fund a fuller consolidation program; the map serves as the Phase 0-scale evidence base for that funding decision.

consumers.text: A working group/commission evaluating whether to fund a fuller consolidation program.

client.authority: No existing body holds cross-agency amendment authority over SBA, USDA, Commerce, Interior, Energy, Education, HHS programs; a proposed OMB coordination mechanism/interagency task force does not yet exist. Posture is advisory.

mutable_core_claims.claim: Multiple agencies collectively are the intended client.
An OMB coordination mechanism or task force could act jointly on the deliverable.
Mutable core is empty for direct amendment today; deliverable is advisory, aimed at informing the eventual creation of an interagency coordination body and a working group's funding decision.

success_criteria.text: A single coherent map/blueprint exists showing every in-scope federal commercial lending subsidy/guarantee program, its current rules and standards, and its stated statutory/regulatory purpose.
Pending/proposed legislative and rulemaking changes are included substantively and clearly flagged throughout as 'not yet law,' distinguished from current authority.
Cross-program divergences and conflicts are captured as an explicit first-class open-items list rather than resolved.
The deliverable is presented to the working group/commission by December 1, 2026 to support its funding decision.

non_goals.text: Resolving cross-program standards conflicts (e.g., differing underwriting/eligibility criteria across SBA/USDA/etc.) — these are documented and set aside, not decided.
Evaluating whether programs still serve their purpose given a changed world — only stated purpose is documented as a factual/citable matter.
Mapping state-level lending programs (state SBDCs, state guarantee funds) in depth — out of scope; federal only.
Consumer/mortgage lending subsidies (FHA, Fannie/Freddie, student consumer credit) — out of scope.
Grants and direct-spending (non-lending) programs — out of scope; only loan guarantee/subsidy lending mechanisms in scope.

two_sentence.note: One long sentence but one project: one deliverable, one client decision, one mode (document, don't resolve). Does not split into two competing sentences.

empty_core.note: Failed as originally scoped — no existing body holds cross-agency amendment authority and the proposed OMB coordination mechanism does not yet exist (A-S3-04). Revived via explicit re-scoping to an advisory posture aimed at a working group's funding decision (A-S3-05, A-S4-01). Recorded as a deliberate re-scoping; a Decision Log entry should capture the revival.

mode_consistency.note: S1 scatter/incoherence (A-S1-01), S2 document-and-set-aside (A-S2-01) and stated-purpose-only (A-S2-02), and S6 advisory map that lists rather than resolves conflicts (A-S6-05) all point to refactor.

open_items.description: Mutable core is empty for direct amendment as scoped; the project is advisory pending the working group's funding decision. This is a deliberate re-scoping (from an initially proposed but non-existent OMB coordination body), not a defect, and must be stated plainly in the deliverable's framing.
open_items.resolves_via: Explicit framing statement in the deliverable and Decision Log entry recording the advisory re-scoping.

open_items.description: Cross-program standards divergences (e.g., underwriting/eligibility criteria across SBA/USDA/etc.) will be documented, not resolved — the explicit open-items list is a first-class required deliverable output.
open_items.resolves_via: Inclusion of divergences as a required section of the deliverable.
